name: demolition-classify
description: TODO G7 — SG demolition/hacking-plan hardening. Classifies a baseline wall load-bearing and one unclassified, then demolishes both (removed from the live plan, still present in `baselinePlan`) so the drawing set's demolition sheet must render a hard 'NOT PERMITTED — load-bearing' danger callout for the classified wall and a '⚠ Structure unverified' warning for the unknown one, plus the concise SG permit-note block. openDrawingSet() opens a new window and calls document.write; window.open is intercepted (stub capturing the written HTML) so the real popup never spawns.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: add-classified-walls
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = window.__store.getState(); const lbWall = { id: 'g7-lb', start: [0,0], end: [3,0], thickness: 'internal', structure: 'load-bearing' }; const unkWall = { id: 'g7-unk', start: [3,0], end: [3,3], thickness: 'internal' }; const withWalls = (plan) => ({ ...plan, walls: [...plan.walls, lbWall, unkWall] }); window.__store.setState({ floorPlan: withWalls(window.__store.getState().floorPlan), baselinePlan: withWalls(window.__store.getState().baselinePlan) }); })()

steps.name: assert-classified-on-live-wall
steps.eval: (function(){ const w = window.__store.getState().floorPlan.walls.find((w) => w.id === 'g7-lb'); if (!w || w.structure !== 'load-bearing') throw new Error('load-bearing classification did not stick on the live wall'); })()

steps.name: demolish-classified-walls
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = window.__store.getState(); window.__store.setState({ floorPlan: { ...s.floorPlan, walls: s.floorPlan.walls.filter((w) => w.id !== 'g7-lb' && w.id !== 'g7-unk') } }); })()

steps.name: patch-window-open
steps.eval: window.__capturedHtml = null; window.__origWindowOpen = window.open; window.open = function () { return { document: { write: function (html) { window.__capturedHtml = html }, close: function () {} }, close: function () {}, focus: function () {}, print: function () {} }; };

steps.name: click-drawing-set
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.pop-panel button')].find(b => b.textContent.includes('Drawing set')); if (!btn) throw new Error('Drawing set button not found'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: wait-html-captured
steps.failMessage: openDrawingSet() never wrote HTML via the intercepted window.open

steps.name: assert-demolition-classification
steps.eval: (function(){ const html = window.__capturedHtml; window.open = window.__origWindowOpen; if (!html.includes('NOT PERMITTED')) throw new Error('missing NOT PERMITTED danger callout for the load-bearing demolished wall'); if (!html.includes('NOT PERMITTED \u2014 load-bearing')) throw new Error('missing the load-bearing NOT PERMITTED legend row text'); if (!html.includes('\u26A0')) throw new Error('missing the \u26A0 warning marker for the unverified demolished wall'); if (!html.includes('Structure unverified')) throw new Error('missing the unverified-structure legend note'); if (!html.includes('class="permit-notes"')) throw new Error('missing the permit-notes block'); if (!html.includes('HDB permit')) throw new Error('missing the HDB permit note text'); if (!html.includes('Professional Engineer') && !html.includes('PE endorsement')) throw new Error('missing the PE endorsement note text'); if (!html.includes('user-declared')) throw new Error('missing the user-declared verification caveat'); if (!html.includes('class="legend"')) throw new Error('missing the demolition legend'); })()
